name: CompOnion
tagline: A companion that answers viewers' questions about a movie in real time without spoilers or interruptions.

awards: MLH: Best AI Application Built with Cloudflare

problem: People interrupt films to ask who someone is or what happened.
solution: An AI companion with context of the film answers questions during viewing.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask "who's that guy again?" mid-scene and get an answer.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best AI Application Built with Cloudflare” among 261 submissions.
Inspired by a viral video about a parent's questions during movies.

lessons: A relatable family moment is a strong opener for a consumer AI tool.
